purpose: Teach: 住友/トルシエ/ディープインパクト/ホリデー/シューティング/師範/ラヴ/ボクサー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん父さん、住友系の会社だったな
lines.en: Riku — your dad works for a Sumitomo company, doesn't he?
lines.style: Casual observation, slight grin. Leaning in with friendly knowingness. Not quite teasing yet, but opening the door to it. Comfortable silence with him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、トルシエ時代のジャパンファンだったな、桜
lines.en: You were obsessed with the Japanese team back during the Troussier era, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft counter-observation. Half-smile — gotcha energy without meanness. Eyes steady, voice light but precise. Remembering something specific about her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ディープインパクトの動画観てたな
lines.en: Riku — you were watching Deep Impact videos, weren't you?
lines.style: Eyebrow raise, conspiratorial tone. Testing him, but affectionately. Quick rhythm. The pleasure of catching someone in something they thought was private.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ホリデーシーズンに旅行行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You went on a trip during the holiday break, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Light follow-up, matching her energy. Tone shifts slightly — less teasing, more genuinely curious now. Quiet satisfaction at volleying back.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、シューティングゲームの全国大会出るんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — you're competing in the national shooting game tournament, aren't you?
lines.style: Surprised admission underneath the casual delivery. A beat of genuine respect before the wry mask slides back. Impressed despite herself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、剣道部の師範に憧れてたな、桜
lines.en: You admired the kendo club instructor, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle callback, but with subtle warmth. Not mean-spirited — he's not trying to embarrass her, just acknowledging he noticed. Steady voice, almost tender.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ラヴソング集ばっか聴いてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were always listening to love songs, weren't you?
lines.style: Knowing smirk in the voice. Wry without cruelty. A little slower, letting the observation land. The pleasure of teasing someone you care about who won't actually mind.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ボクサーの映画好きだったな、桜
lines.en: You liked those boxer movies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, close observation. Almost intimate — he's admitting he was paying attention. Not defensive, just remembering. A small, genuine smile underneath the words.
